title: Arkret Holder Quarantine
description: Closed plaintext account-data cell value of ak.account.holder_quarantine. The recipient Station is the sole CAS writer; the cell is a pending-review pointer inbox and grants no membership, contact, or consent authority. surface_kind is the closed discriminator: invite_delivery entries reference an accepted invite Event and its introduction evidence, consent_request entries reference no Event at all. Contact delivery is not a branch here: a Contact request has its own pending_incoming state and MUST NOT get a second parallel review carrier.

updated_at.description: Instant of the accepted Station CAS write that produced this value.

quarantine_entries.description: Bounded pending-review entries, oldest first. Expired entries are purged before a write and overflow evicts the oldest entries.

last_invalidation.description: Optional diagnostic for the latest accepted consent-revoke invalidation. It is holder-private and never disclosed to the requester.

surface_kind.description: Closed discriminator for the admission surface that produced this entry. An unregistered value fails closed.

quarantine_entry.description: One pending-review quarantined admission. Membership in quarantine_entries is the only state this cell expresses: an entry is pending review until the holder reviews it or its TTL discards it, so no status member is carried. The two surface_kind branches are closed and mutually exclusive; a member declared by the other branch is a schema violation.

entry_digest.description: Recipient-service-local stable deduplication digest for this quarantined delivery.

account_id.description: Exact holder of this account-data cell and recipient of the quarantined invite. The sole CAS writer is account_id.station_id; another account with the same principal core is a different holder.

source_peer_principal_id.description: Requester/inviter principal used by consent review and revoke invalidation.

source_id.description: Authenticated transport source service DID. It never participates in the new-source quota identity key.

consent_scope.description: Requested consent scope. The invite_delivery branch pins it to invite; the consent_request branch admits every other registered scope. The enum mirrors zh/identity/consent-model.md section 4.

introduction_kind.description: Introduction evidence kind presented by the requester. invite_delivery branch only; a consent request has no introduction evidence, so any value there would be fabricated.

invite_event_id.description: Accepted invite Event identity. Its suite-tagged token is the sole wire source for the complete Event digest.

request_digest.description: Replay deduplication digest of the invite delivery request. invite_delivery branch only: ak.self.consent.command.request.v1 declares idempotency_mechanism none and carries no nonce, so its branch deduplicates by live-entry uniqueness instead.

idempotency_key_digest.description: Digest of the invite delivery Idempotency-Key. invite_delivery branch only, for the same reason as request_digest.

expires_at.description: Deployment-policy TTL. An expired entry is discarded and never converts to a grant.
